# RB3 Charts

Read and follow the repository root `AGENTS.md` for architecture, commands,
data exclusions and branch workflow. Read `docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md` before
chart-engine changes. Keep each change scoped and report the tests actually run.

Comparison reports and official/reference charts are evaluation evidence only.
Never use reference notes as generation inputs, copy an authored note sequence,
or special-case a song, artist, title, timestamp, or reference chart ID. Diagnose
the responsible subsystem and implement a general musical rule. Use cached event
replay for controlled before/after checks when it is locally available. Clearly
separate automated metrics and tests from listening review and Xbox playtesting.
